full_judgment:
This Rule, under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure is directed against the judgment and decree dated 16-3-91, passed by the Second Sub-Judge Khulna, in Title Appeal No. 35 of 1988, reversing those of the Assistant Judge, Khulna passed on 18-12-87, in Title Suit No. 160 of 1984. 

 4. The learned Assistant Judge on consideration of the evidence and other materials on record dismissed the suit. Against that the plaintiff-petitioner preferred an appeal before the learned District Judge, which was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, Khulna who allowed the appeal, set aside the order passed by the trial Court and directed the defendants to re-instate the plaintiff-petitioner in his service with all benefits, within 120 days from the date of the decree. 

 5. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree passed by the Appellate Court, the defendant-petitioners have obtained the present Rule. 

 8. Mr. Asrarul Hossain assailed the impugned judgment and decree on various other grounds as well. He argues that the plaintiff is a worker under Sonali Bank but Sonali Bank having not been made a party, the suit is not maintainable in law against its officers and is liable to be dismissed on that ground alone. In support of his contention he cited an unreported decision of the Appellate Division in the case of Md. Arfan Ali vs. Sonali Bank and others, Civil Petition for Special Leave to Appeal No. 26 of 1992. In that case the petitioner who was an employee of Sonali Bank was dismissed from service but in his petition before the Administrative Tribunal, he did not implead Sonali Bank, his employer, as a party to the petition but made an Assistant General Manager of Sonali Bank as defendant No. 1. 

 10. In view of the provisions of President's Order 26 and the finding of the Appellate Division as noted above, the impugned decree cannot be sustained in law. 

 17. In the result, the Rule is made absolute. The impugned judgment and the decree are set aside and the suit being Title Suit No. 160 of 1984 is dismissed.
